Doom engine and base game assets

Unmodified binaries and Freedoom 0.13.0 assets from danborden1/doom-web at e0ba81004e27e7d66141925dfebb091a558e2fe8.
https://github.com/danborden1/doom-web/tree/e0ba81004e27e7d66141925dfebb091a558e2fe8

Engine: GPL v2; COPYING included. Corresponding source is included as engine-source.tar.gz, from https://github.com/Saketh-Chandra/doom-wasm-pwa/tree/a77edfd8bbc7 (a Chocolate Doom / cloudflare/doom-wasm fork). Build instructions are in that archive.

Freedoom game data: BSD 3-clause; FREEDOOM-COPYING.txt and FREEDOOM-CREDITS.txt included. No commercial Doom game data is bundled.

Freedoom Phase 2: freedoom2.wad from the official Freedoom 0.13.0 release, https://github.com/freedoom/freedoom/releases/tag/v0.13.0 . The same BSD license and credits apply.

Node builder: unmodified ZDBSP WebAssembly wrapper artifacts from seanmorris/zdbsp-wasm at acc45bf6b2232a75bdbb0b6295822e72e13dfeec. Git blob SHA1: Zdbsp.mjs 80aa83b4da1a38d3e01458b7660974cb8ce3cb87; zdbsp.wasm ba4c8f15c6a594d6618af73cebe3691184bd8b0b. ZDBSP is GPL v2; ZDBSP-COPYING is included. Wrapper/build source: zdbsp-wasm-source.tar.gz at that commit. Upstream C++ source: zdbsp-source.tar.gz, rheit/zdbsp ea4d41c589b0a0788a1083facfbcc3952cd1e2ff (the last upstream commit before the wrapper's publication). The wrapper's Makefile did not pin its upstream checkout; this upstream source revision is recorded explicitly rather than claiming a binary build attestation. https://github.com/rheit/zdbsp and https://github.com/seanmorris/zdbsp-wasm .
